about.name: Sarah Gu
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer in New York. Graduated Columbia in 2024, spent a year at Citadel Securities, and left this April to start working on something new.
Earlier on: three summers at MITRE doing ML work, then internships at Microsoft, Meta, Phia, and Vivid.
Outside of that I'm usually running, at the gym, eating, or out with my camera.

experience.details: Left Citadel in April 2026 to start working on something new. Heads-down on it now - happy to talk about it over coffee if you reach out.

experience.blurb: One of the world's leading market-making firms.
experience.details: Joined full-time after interning the summer before, on a full-stack team. Spent a year shipping internal tooling for trading systems before leaving in April 2026 to build something new.

experience.blurb: Pre-seed-stage secondhand e-commerce startup led by Phoebe Gates & Sophia Kianni.
experience.details: Built out a pipeline for tracking purchases via affiliate-link UTM parameters, scraping data from 5+ partner networks and streaming into BigQuery. Set up a daily cron job on GCP. Owned the Amplitude analytics dashboard, instrumenting 30+ user-interaction metrics including DAU/MAU, AOV, and retention.

experience.blurb: Pre-seed, three-person startup converting Figma designs to frontend code.
experience.details: Owned the company's onboarding workflow - built an AI-powered internal tool that automatically links React components to their corresponding Figma designs. Designed and shipped the entire UX, prototyping in Figma and implementing in React, TypeScript, and Tailwind. Sat in on client meetings, investor updates, and customer-validation calls.

Engineered a new monitoring pipeline for Azure App Services, yielding a 30× improvement in the number of metrics logged. Synthesized data from 2,500+ cloud servers and wired together 4+ Azure platforms to cleanly stream logs into a Kusto database. Deployed to production, where it now actively tracks all Azure App Service servers on the cloud.

experience.blurb: Facebook University - Meta's program for early-career engineers.
experience.details: Independently developed a note-sharing and transcribing iOS app in Xcode and Objective-C, using Apple's Core ML API to convert handwriting in images to text. Programmed sort-by-class, search-by-caption, and find-friends functionality.

experience.blurb: Federally-funded R&D center. Three summers on the Core Health Radar & Detection team.
experience.details: 2020 - implemented 10+ IR-image detection networks and produced a 93%-accurate model that outperformed an external client's needs (PyTorch & TensorFlow). 2019 - discovered a vulnerability in the BERT model to an adversarial data-leaking attack; white-box simulations exposed up to 70% of training data across 15+ deep-learning tests. 2018 - engineered a machine-learning pipeline to decipher thought, designing neural-net architectures that decode brainwaves from denoised EEG data into text.

projects.name: Speedster

projects.name: Goji Health
projects.description: AI-powered startup predicting demand for healthcare supply-chain services. Interviewed hospital supply-chain directors nationwide to validate the problem.

projects.name: Senior Scramble

projects.name: Graze Pro
projects.description: Rotational-grazing prediction app built at TreeHacks. We got robbed hours before the hackathon and built the whole thing on three dorm monitors at Stanford.

projects.name: FortuneGPT
projects.description: GPT-3-powered app that generates personalized fortunes and horoscopes.

projects.name: Birthday Countdown
projects.description: Animated birthday countdown with photos and confetti. React + Tailwind.

projects.name: Sound Match
projects.description: Audio-matching game that tests your ear for different frequencies and tunes. React + Tailwind.

projects.name: CoronaVoice
projects.description: NLP-based COVID screening tool that analyzes changes in vocal inflection to flag potential infection.

projects.name: Fishbowl
